_doc: Licensed or account-bound components found by package id or assembly reference (case-insensitive regex, anchored). kind: licensed = a commercial licence or licence key; saas = needs an account or agent key. Used by third_party.py with the online NuGet licence text; add a row when a client uses a vendor that is missing. Unlisted packages are not guessed.

components.note: Licence key; some editions bind the licence to the machine or domain.
Commercial use needs a licence; the licence may name the site domain.
Licence key file; build agents need the licence too.
Licence key; build agents need the licence too.
AGPL or commercial licence; commercial use needs a licence file.
Needs the service account or licence key.

integration_key_groups._doc: Environment variable and setting names are grouped by their vendor word after the application prefix. These words are infrastructure, not integrations; they are counted as connection values instead.
